COURSE_OBJECTIVE: Ensure officers who handle funds understand the Financial Regulations, budget implementation and the controls that protect public money.
COURSE_DESCRIPTION: Covers the budget cycle, the Treasury Single Account, authorisation and payment controls, retirement of advances, and internal and external audit.

general_quiz.QUIZ_UPLOAD_INSTRUCTION: Answer all questions. Select one option per question and submit before the timer runs out.
general_quiz.QUIZ_DESCRIPTION: Final assessment for Financial Regulations & Budget Discipline.

questions.QUIZ_QUESTION: Which is the correct order of the budget cycle?
questions.QUIZ_ANSWER: Preparation, approval, implementation, monitoring and evaluation
QUIZ_OPTIONS: Preparation, approval, implementation, monitoring and evaluation

questions.QUIZ_QUESTION: Spending money on an item not in the approved budget without authorisation is...
QUIZ_OPTIONS: Acceptable if the item is useful

questions.QUIZ_ANSWER: To compare actual spending with plans and correct deviations
QUIZ_OPTIONS: To compare actual spending with plans and correct deviations

questions.QUIZ_QUESTION: What is the main purpose of the Treasury Single Account?
questions.QUIZ_ANSWER: To consolidate government revenues into a single account at the Central Bank for better control
QUIZ_OPTIONS: To consolidate government revenues into a single account at the Central Bank for better control
To allow each agency to open many commercial accounts

questions.QUIZ_ANSWER: No single officer controls all stages of a transaction
QUIZ_OPTIONS: No single officer controls all stages of a transaction
Finance staff work in separate buildings
One officer approves, pays and records everything

questions.QUIZ_QUESTION: Before a payment is made, it should be...
questions.QUIZ_ANSWER: Properly authorised, supported by documents and within budget
QUIZ_OPTIONS: Properly authorised, supported by documents and within budget

questions.QUIZ_ANSWER: Accounting for how the advance was spent, with receipts, and refunding any balance
QUIZ_OPTIONS: Accounting for how the advance was spent, with receipts, and refunding any balance
Keeping the balance as a bonus

questions.QUIZ_QUESTION: What is the role of internal audit?
questions.QUIZ_ANSWER: To independently review controls and compliance within the organisation
QUIZ_OPTIONS: To independently review controls and compliance within the organisation

questions.QUIZ_ANSWER: Recovery from salary and possible disciplinary action
QUIZ_OPTIONS: Recovery from salary and possible disciplinary action
